I checked, and the premise doesn't hold: this repo's `.git` is only 133K (project total 274K), and even the parent `sentinel` repo's `.git` is just 21M — nowhere near "several gigabytes." `git count-objects -v` shows 42 loose objects, 18 bytes, no packs, no garbage.

Since there's no actual bloat here, I'm not going to run any cleanup/pruning (`git gc`, `rm -rf`, reflog expiry, etc.) — those would be destructive and there's nothing to fix. If you're seeing multi-GB disk usage, it's likely coming from somewhere else (a different repo/worktree, `node_modules`, build artifacts, or a different drive/path). Let me know the actual path you're looking at and I can check it instead.
